digest: finding-004 KEEP: SPEC T3 names launchRetryAttempts as a public contract field, but src/workflow-terminal.ts exposes launchRetries and nothing in the repo defines launchRetryAttempts.

evidence.relevance: Spec requires the summary field named launchRetryAttempts as the total launch retry count across all tasks

evidence.quote: 이 두 필드 이름은 공개 계약이다(외부 도구가 읽는다).
evidence.relevance: Spec states these field names are a public contract read by external tools, so the name is not cosmetic
Summary interface declares the launch retry total under the name launchRetries, not launchRetryAttempts
Summary object literal emits the field as launchRetries, so the published field name deviates from the spec

finalClaim: The terminal summary publishes the launch retry total as launchRetries, but SPEC.md T3 requires the public contract name launchRetryAttempts. A repository-wide search finds no launchRetryAttempts identifier or alias anywhere in the code, so the name deviation is confirmed.
recommendedAction: Rename the summary field launchRetries to launchRetryAttempts in the WorkflowTerminalSummary interface and the summarizeWorkflowTerminal return value, or keep a launchRetryAttempts field alongside any compatibility alias and update consumers. Add a unit test that asserts the exact field name and that its value is the sum of task launchRetry.attempts.
